name: mlx-prefill-multi
hypothesis: mlx-arith tier. mlx-prefill plus mlx_multi: the unsplit MLX-arithmetic products that share an input (q/k/v projections; w1 and w3) in one launch (mk_mlx_qmm_multi), each tile exactly mk_mlx_qmm_t's, so the outputs keep stock MLX's bits; only launches and the barriers between them go (stock MLX overlaps such independent kernels too). Profile at 1,024 (after the dtype-specialised qmm): qmm 205 of 221.5 ms GPU; per-launch tail and barrier cost of the 46 separate launches is ~1-2%. Screens: +1.0% at 1,024, +0.4% at 4,096, +1.4% at 64 over mlx-prefill on the same binary. Expect +1% prefill.
